title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I have a 3 year old daughter, I kept her name as Daania. Please tell whether this name is correct. Please suggest some good names if it is not correct. 2342 views Q. My daughter's name is Afia Ibnat. Is it correct according to our Shariat? Please tell me the Meaning of this name. 6851 views Q. اصفا فاطمہ (Aasfa fathima) نام کے بارے میں بتائیں۔کیا یہ نام شریعت کی روشنی میں درست ہے؟براہ کرم، کوئی ایسا نام بتائیں جو بہت زیادہ اچھا ہو اور اس کے بہت سارے فضائل ہوں۔ میں اپنی بیٹی کا نام رکھنا چاہتاہوں جو کل پیدا ہوئی ہے۔ 1764 views Q. I want to know the meaning of girl name "Hudaibia". Because I would like to name my daughter Hudaibia, but I am not sure of the meaning. Please reply me as soon as possible and also suggest me some names if hudaibia is not permissible. 4108 views Q. My name is Subhan Ahmad. I want to know that whether this name is allowed in Shariah? If not, then what should I do now? 4213 views Q. I have kept my son’s name according to a Sahabah (RZ) name. His name is MIQDAD AHMED NUBAID. Is it ok. If not, what should I do now. He is 1.5 years old now. 3119 views Q. Daughter name and Aqiqah 2141 views Q. Is the name "Amal Junaid" correct for my daughter? 6349 views Q. Can I keep ‘Ada’ as a girl name? 3286 views Q. Islamic name for my son 4005 views Q. Correct spelling of Names 10526 views Q. Pls advice me can i keep my sons name as: Arshaan (persian name), Arhaan, Arhaam and arham. Are these name islamically valid? 6272 views Q. I want to keep my daughter's name "Zayna" which means "Very Beautiful".. Is it an arabic name? And can I keep it? 5865 views Q. Change in Name 1912 views Q. چالیس دن پہلے اللہ کے فضل سے بیٹی ہوئی ہے، ہم نے اس کا نام انابیہ (Anabia)رکھا ہے ۔ لوگ کہتے ہیں کہ یہ عربی یا اسلامی نام نہیں ہے ۔ 13734 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 42340 Country: India Title: Name Question: My wife is expected to deliver soon in-shaAllah we would like to know if it is appropriate to keep the new born (if baby girl) name as "Fathima Mujahed", kindly suggest any good names. Appreciate your quick reply. Answer ID: 42340 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1667/1071/L=1433) You can keep the name ’Fatimah Mujahed’ in case it is a girl. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
